method: honest OOS: calibration residuals from 2024 train (weeks 4-18, true scoring via scoring.py DEFAULT_SCORING), evaluated once on 2025 holdout (weeks 4-18). Raw via conformal.empirical_coverage() (single qhat width, no scaling). Displayed via projection.py heuristic scaling (pos_factor * point_factor, clamped 3-14) per-row — measure only, widths frozen.
source: data/ml/val_2025.jsonl (derived from data/nfl_cache/stats_*.json + schedule; cache exists at data/nfl_cache/, never /private/tmp scratch path) + data/ml/train_2023_2024.jsonl (2024 slice) for calibration
note: 80% is target, not guarantee (conformal.py). Raw QB undercovers (0.58) — fat tails for stars; displayed QB improves (0.79) via 1.45x factor but K undercovers (0.59) via 0.55x narrow factor. Widths frozen for display stability — this file only measures, never retunes.
